title: Problem 02
markdown:
### Problem
Find all real number pairs $(x, y)$ satisfying the following equations:

$$\begin{aligned} x + y - \lfloor y \rfloor &= 30.1 \\ x + \lfloor x \rfloor + \lfloor y \rfloor &= 71.7 \end{aligned}$$

(Recall that for real numbers $u$, $\lfloor u \rfloor$ denotes the greatest integer not exceeding $u$.)

### Solution (adapted from the official solution)
The unique solution is $x = 29.7, y = 13.4$.

Write $x = m + \{x\}$ and $y = n + \{y\}$, where $m = \lfloor x \rfloor, n = \lfloor y \rfloor \in \mathbb{Z}$ and $\{x\}, \{y\} \in [0, 1)$.

The equations become:
1. $x + \{y\} = 30.1$
2. $x + m + n = 71.7 \implies 2m + n + \{x\} = 71.7$

Since $2m + n$ is an integer, the fractional part of the left side is $\{x\}$, so $\{x\} = 0.7$.
Thus $x = m + 0.7$.

Substituting $x = m + 0.7$ into the first equation:
$$m + 0.7 + \{y\} = 30.1 \implies m + \{y\} = 29.4.$$
Since $m$ is an integer and $\{y\} \in [0, 1)$, we must have:
$$m = 29 \quad \text{and} \quad \{y\} = 0.4.$$
Hence $x = 29 + 0.7 = 29.7$.

Now substitute $x = 29.7$ and $m = 29$ into the second equation:
$$29.7 + 29 + n = 71.7 \implies 58.7 + n = 71.7 \implies n = 13.$$

Therefore $y = n + \{y\} = 13 + 0.4 = 13.4$.

The unique solution is $(x, y) = (29.7, 13.4)$.

### Conceptual Explanation
Separating each variable into integer and fractional parts reveals $\{x\} = 0.7$ directly from equation 2. Equation 1 then splits uniquely into integer part $m = 29$ and fractional part $\{y\} = 0.4$. Finally, equation 2 gives $n = 13$, producing $(29.7, 13.4)$.

### Key Technique
Decomposition into integer and fractional parts $u = \lfloor u \rfloor + \{u\}$.
